previewDeathNotice.description: Died peacefully on November 18th, 2014 at the Midland Regional Hospital, Portlaoise. Beloved husband of the late Elizabeth; deeply regretted by his loving daughters Elizabeth and Margaret, sons-in-law Pat and Andy, grandchildren Kevan and his wife Sylwia, Brendan, Conor, Matthew, Christopher, Dominic and Tom, nieces, nephews, relatives and friends. RIP. Reposing at Maher’s Chapel of Rest, Portarlington tomorrow, Wednesday evening, from 6 o’clock with Rosary at 7.30 o’clock. Removal on Thursday morning at 11:15 o’clock arriving at St. John’s Church, Killenard for Requiem Mass at 12 o’clock. Interment afterwards in the adjoining cemetery. Family flowers only please. Donations if desired to the local St Vincent de Paul Society.
